description: This is a migration script for the Superset project, specifically renaming a JSON key within dashboard metadata during upgrade and downgrade operations.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative ORM class representing the dashboards table with id and json_metadata fields.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs a database migration to rename 'filter_configuration' to 'native_filter_configuration' in dashboard JSON metadata.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the migration by renaming 'native_filter_configuration' back to 'filter_configuration' in dashboard JSON metadata.
